schema_scope: Project recipe convention; not a discovery standard.

recipes.task: Check a selected passage against a retained report
recipes.scope: Synthetic source and report; local bytes only.

recipes.task: Find missing evidence for an earlier source date
recipes.scope: Synthetic June capture; April policy remains unresolved.

recipes.task: Check a complete retained report
recipes.scope: Synthetic complete report; selected passages only.

recipes.task: Check an output against the operands used
recipes.scope: Synthetic local execution record; declared operands only.

recipes.task: Check a claim against a captured authority
recipes.scope: Synthetic authority capture; no source authentication or live fetch.

recipes.task: Check bounded absence in a declared interval
recipes.scope: Synthetic observation; consumer-selected interval and producer.

recipes.task: Check absence within a selected observation vantage
recipes.scope: Synthetic selected scope; outside effects remain uncovered.

recipes.task: Detect an observed write that contradicts absence
recipes.scope: Synthetic target observation; selected write only.

recipes.task: Keep a self-reported write separate from observation
recipes.scope: Synthetic self-report; no separately observed target effect.

recipes.task: Replay a budget reservation journal
recipes.scope: Synthetic prices and journal; no provider billing execution.

recipes.task: Check broker-recorded file completion
recipes.scope: Synthetic signed broker records; public fixture keys; PEER scope only.

recipes.task: Check that an agent left its protected tests alone
recipes.scope: Synthetic observer records; PEER scope; recorded paths only.

recipes.task: Detect a planted conftest.py in a protected test directory
recipes.scope: Synthetic observer records; PEER scope; recorded paths only.

recipes.task: Keep protected-path absence open when observer events were lost
recipes.scope: Synthetic observer records with unknown coverage.

recipes.task: Check acceptance graded outside the agent on its final tree
recipes.scope: Synthetic grade and tree records; PEER scope.

recipes.task: Detect acceptance that fails when the verifier reruns it
recipes.scope: Synthetic grade and tree records; PEER scope.

recipes.task: Refuse support from a contract that killed no mutant
recipes.scope: Synthetic contract with zero mutation adequacy.

recipes.task: Match a claimed test run to an observed exec after the last edit
recipes.scope: Synthetic observer records; exact argv; PEER scope.

recipes.task: Detect a claimed test run that never executed
recipes.scope: Synthetic observer records; exact argv; PEER scope.

recipes.task: Keep a claimed run open when observer events were lost
recipes.scope: Synthetic observer records with unknown coverage.

recipes.task: Accept done, ungamed work from a receipt whose two verdicts derive again
recipes.scope: Synthetic records and an unsigned receipt Statement; PEER scope.

recipes.task: Refuse work that passed its tests while the agent tampered with the grader
recipes.scope: Synthetic records and an unsigned receipt Statement; PEER scope.

recipes.task: Refuse unfinished work an honest agent did not claim done
recipes.scope: Synthetic records and an unsigned receipt Statement; PEER scope.

recipes.task: Check an agent's completion assertion against the runs the observer saw
recipes.scope: Synthetic observer records; PEER scope.

recipes.task: Check a contract's oracle-free probes on a split whose behavioural tests passed
recipes.scope: Synthetic verifier grade; PEER scope.

recipes.task: Detect a done receipt that reports verdicts its records do not give
recipes.scope: Synthetic records and an unsigned receipt Statement; PEER scope.
